description: A shell script for testing and demonstrating git log options, including commit graph creation, merge operations, and various log output formats and filters.

methods.name: note
methods.description: Creates a git tag with the given name.

methods.name: unnote
methods.description: Generates a revision name annotation, cleaning up the output.

methods.name: check_outcome
methods.description: Runs git log with specified parameters and compares output to expected.

methods.name: check_result
methods.description: Wrapper for check_outcome to verify successful git log output.
